title: 算 Step 3 · Fractions, Decimals, Percent and Minus: 分之, 点, 百分之, 负
description: 四分之三 = ¾ — the bottom comes first! Then decimals (三点五, 零点零八), percentages (百分之二十) and negatives (负五).

points.title: 分之: the bottom number first
points.summary: B 分之 A = A/B: '(out of) B parts, A of them'. 四分之三 = ¾.
points.body:
- 二**分之**一 = ½ (also **一半**)
- 三分之二 = ⅔
- 四分之一 = ¼
- Percent works the same way: **百分之**二十 = 20/100 = 20%.

| | say | example |
|---|---|---|
| **+** | 加 jiā | 三**加**五**等于**八 (3 + 5 = 8) |
| **−** | 减 jiǎn | 十**减**四等于六 (10 − 4 = 6) |
| **×** | 乘 / 乘以 chéng(yǐ) | 六**乘以**七等于四十二 |
| **÷** | 除以 chúyǐ | 十**除以**二等于五 · ⚠️ 二**除**十 = 10 ÷ 2 too! |
| **=** | 等于 děngyú | (spoken: 是) |
| **¾** | 四**分之**三 — bottom number first | 二分之一 = ½ |
| **3.5 · 20% · −5** | 三**点**五 · **百分之**二十 · **负**五 | 0.08 = 零点零八 |
| **×2 · 20% off** | 两**倍** · 打**八折** (pay 80%) | 增加了一倍 = doubled |
examples: {四分之三|sì fēn zhī sān}{的|de}{学生|xuésheng}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{中文|Zhōngwén}。
Three quarters of the students speak Chinese.

points.title: 点, 百分之, 负
points.summary: 3.5 = 三**点**五 (digits after the point one by one: 0.25 = 零点二五). 20% = **百分之**二十. −5 = **负**五.
points.body:
- 零点零八 = 0.08
- 百分之五 = 5%
- 负五度 = −5° (weather often says 零下五度)

| | say | example |
|---|---|---|
| **+** | 加 jiā | 三**加**五**等于**八 (3 + 5 = 8) |
| **−** | 减 jiǎn | 十**减**四等于六 (10 − 4 = 6) |
| **×** | 乘 / 乘以 chéng(yǐ) | 六**乘以**七等于四十二 |
| **÷** | 除以 chúyǐ | 十**除以**二等于五 · ⚠️ 二**除**十 = 10 ÷ 2 too! |
| **=** | 等于 děngyú | (spoken: 是) |
| **¾** | 四**分之**三 — bottom number first | 二分之一 = ½ |
| **3.5 · 20% · −5** | 三**点**五 · **百分之**二十 · **负**五 | 0.08 = 零点零八 |
| **×2 · 20% off** | 两**倍** · 打**八折** (pay 80%) | 增加了一倍 = doubled |
examples: {今天|jīntiān}{便宜|piányi}{百分之二十|bǎi fēn zhī èrshí}。

questions.prompt: Bottom first! Which fraction is each?
questions.explanation: B **分之** A = A/B — the bottom number comes first.

questions.prompt: Why is ¾ said 「{四分之三|sì fēn zhī sān}」?
options: It's a mistake for 三分之四.
'Divided into 4 parts, 3 of them' — the whole comes first.
Chinese reads fractions right to left.
questions.explanation: **分之** = 'of the parts': whole first, then the part.
notes: It's not about direction — it's whole first, then the part.

questions.explanation: **五分之二** — five parts, two of them.
